How to play

← / → or A / D to run; Space, ↑, or W to jump. Hold longer to jump higher.

  • Hit ? boxes from below: a 50% chance of 3 energy or 1 heart (max 3 hearts). Each box opens once per run.
  • Press X to spend 1 energy and stun a cat for 5 seconds. Jump on it while stunned to defeat it.
  • Falling or touching an active enemy costs 1 heart and returns you to a checkpoint. Lose all 3 hearts and the run ends.
  • Find three stars, one in each section. Each new star gives 10 coins, once. Collected stars stay saved and disappear on replays.
  • Green flags mark 4 checkpoints. A brief shield protects you after respawning.
  • Reach the flag beside the green door to finish. Replay to find any missed stars.

P or Escape pauses or resumes. Switching tabs pauses automatically.
